items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: She said some bad things about how you and she were the two big stars with Gene's band

ctx.x: She said some bad things about how you and she were the two big stars with Gene's band, there might have been some tension... You should read it, because I'm sure that what she says in there is not... It doesn't sound right to me.
I'm sure of that! I don't have it.
